title: Parity tree computes full parity
statement: Let $n,r,h$ be natural numbers and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, with $n\le r^h$. The value at index $0$ of the depth-$h$ parity tree with branching parameter $r$ is the product of all coordinates of $x$, namely $\prod_{i=0}^{n-1}x_i$.
